mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 10, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: ice01: pale blue ice washed with snow.
animation_note: Rigged: 3 bones, one action of 21 keys. Plays at 0.16.
effects_note: No arm in MuMain's WD_2DEVIAS switches beyond its clip. Noria's blue light on its own Object10/36 is gated to Noria (ornaments.cpp).
